trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (trimmed_mean on pool1) and the runner-up margin is only 0.00469 with an 'indistinguishable' verdict. Per the stopping rule, when the leader is a seed and the gap is not statistically distinguishable, accepting is the right call. The pool1 (top-5 stable models: ARIMA, ETS, THETA, FT_rf, ONLY_DWT_catboost) already captures the best-performing, least-redundant models for this strongly-trended, seasonal series, and the trimmed mean provides robustness against the moderate ranking instability.

action_args.justification: The series has a strong upward trend (0.95) and strong 12-month seasonality (0.66), making it highly predictable. The top-5 stable models (ARIMA, ETS, THETA, FT_rf, ONLY_DWT_catboost) capture the trend and seasonal structure well, and the trimmed mean (trim=0.2) provides robustness against the moderate ranking instability (Kendall tau 0.32) and correlated-error redundancy (9 groups, 4 independent). The leader is a seed baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable (margin 0.0047), so further tuning is unlikely to yield a real gain over 3 validation windows.
